requirements.text: RModelElement is a class that belongs to SimpleRDBMS package. It has an attribute named "kind" of type "String"
Schema class belongs to SimpleRDBMS package
Table is a class in the SimpleRDBMS package
Column is a class in SimpleRDBMS package. It has an attribute named "type" of type "String"
Key is a class in SimpleRDBMS package
ForeignKey is a class in SimpleRDBMS package
A Schema is composed of 0 or several Tables in an RDBMS
A Table is associated to one and only one Schema in an RDBMS
A Table is composed of 0 or several keys in an RDBMS
A Column is owned by one and only one Table in an RDBMS
A Column is associated to 0 or several foreign keys
A Key is owned by one and only one Table in an RDBMS
A Key refers to 0 or several opposite foreign keys in an RDBMS
A Foreign Key concerns 0 or several Columns in an RDBMS
A Foreign Key refers to one and only one Key in an RDBMS
